Compare {{cog|nds|Water}}, {{cog|nl|water}}, {{cog|en|water}}, {{cog|da|vand}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|de|/ˈvasər/}}, {{IPAchar|[ˈva.sɐ]|[ˈva.səʁ]}} * {{audio|de|De-Wasser.ogg}} * {{audio|de|De-Wasser3.ogg|a=<> (<>)}} * {{audio|de|BY-Wasser.ogg|a=Bavaria}} * {{hyph|de|Was|ser}} ===Noun=== {{de-noun|n,,-:^|dim=^chen,^lein}} # [[water]] {{gloss|H₂O}} # [[water]], [[waters]] {{gl|body of water, especially a river or lake}} # {{lb|de|chiefly in compounds}} alcoholic beverage, similar to [[brandy]], made from fermented fruit # {{lb|de|literary|euphemistic}} [[urine]] #: {{coi|de|'''Wasser''' lassen|to urinate}} # {{lb|de|colloquial}} {{clipping of|de|[[Mineralwasser]]/[[Tafelwasser]]}} ====Usage notes==== * Both plural forms are infrequent. Unchanged '''''Wasser''''' is used as a purely emphatic plural: ''die '''Wasser''' des Rheins'' – the '''waters''' of the Rhine. '''''Wässer''''' is used as an actual plural meaning different kinds of water (or brandy): ''teure und preiswerte '''Wässer''''' – expensive and inexpensive [table] '''waters'''. However, ''Wässer'' is also used emphatically in some compound words such as {{m|de|Abwässer|Ab'''wässer'''|waste water}} and {{m|de|Schmutzwässer|Schmutz'''wässer'''|dirty water}}. ====Declension====
